p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6cfef789.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    n = len(grid)\n    rotations = [grid, [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])], [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]], [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]]\n    out = [[0] * (2 * n) for _ in range(2 * n)]\n    for r in range(n):\n        out[r][:n] = rotations[0][r]\n        out[r][n:] = rotations[1][r]\n        out[r+n][:n] = rotations[3][r]\n        out[r+n][n:] = rotations[2][r]\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
